The database schema we have here is named 'rschema_0426'. It consists of five tables: 'User', 'Attraction', 'User_Bookmark', 'Ticket_Reservation_Record', and 'User_Comment'.
The 'User' table represents the users of the application. It has five columns: 'Account', 'Bio', 'Nickname', 'Password'. The 'Account' column is the primary key of this table.
The 'Attraction' table represents the attractions that users can visit. It has five columns: 'Attraction_ID', 'Name', 'Picture_URL', 'Reference_Price', and 'Text_Description'. 'Attraction_ID' is the primary key of this table.
The 'User_Bookmark' table represents the bookmarks of users. It has two columns: 'Account' and 'Attraction_ID'. Both columns are not null and together form the primary key of this table. The 'Account' column references the 'Account' column in the 'User' table and the 'Attraction_ID' column references the 'Attraction_ID' column in the 'Attraction' table.
The 'Ticket_Reservation_Record' table represents the ticket reservations made by users. It has five columns: 'Attraction_ID', 'Number_of_Tickets_Purchased', 'Reservation_Time', 'Ticket_Purchase_Time', and 'User_Account'. 'User_Account' and 'Attraction_ID' together form the primary key of this table. The 'Attraction_ID' column references the 'Attraction_ID' column in the 'Attraction' table and the 'User_Account' column references the 'Account' column in the 'User' table.
Finally, the 'User_Comment' table represents the comments made by users. It has five columns: 'Attraction_ID', 'Comment_Content', 'Comment_Status', 'Comment_Time', and 'User_Account'. 'User_Account' and 'Attraction_ID' together form the primary key of this table. The 'Attraction_ID' column references the 'Attraction_ID' column in the 'Attraction' table and the 'User_Account' column references the 'Account' column in the 'User' table.
gold_question: The mini-program shall allow users to register or log in via WeChat authorization. The system shall store each user's account information (such as account number, password, nickname, bio, etc.) and related authorization information, enabling users to view some attraction information after logging in, including attraction name, pictures, reference prices, and text descriptions. Users shall be able to bookmark attractions they are interested in and submit reservation information, recording the reservation time, ticket purchase time, number of tickets purchased, etc., for later viewing or modification. Users shall also be able to submit brief comments for attractions, including comment time, comment content, comment status, etc., which shall be displayed on the front-end only after back-end review.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0426
CREATE TABLE `User` (
  `Account` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `Bio` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `Nickname` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Password` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Account`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `Attraction` (
  `Attraction_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `Picture_URL` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Reference_Price` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Text_Description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Attraction_ID`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `User_Bookmark` (
  `Account` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `Attraction_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Account`, `Attraction_ID`),
  CONSTRAINT `User_Bookmark_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`Account`) REFERENCES `User` (`Account`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `User_Bookmark_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`Attraction_ID`) REFERENCES `Attraction` (`Attraction_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `Ticket_Reservation_Record` (
  `Attraction_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Number_of_Tickets_Purchased` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Reservation_Time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `Ticket_Purchase_Time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `User_Account` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`User_Account`, `Attraction_ID`),
  CONSTRAINT `Ticket_Reservation_Record_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`Attraction_ID`) REFERENCES `Attraction` (`Attraction_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `Ticket_Reservation_Record_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`User_Account`) REFERENCES `User` (`Account`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `User_Comment` (
  `Attraction_ID` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `Comment_Content` text NOT NULL,
  `Comment_Status` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `Comment_Time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `User_Account` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`User_Account`, `Attraction_ID`),
  CONSTRAINT `User_Comment_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`Attraction_ID`) REFERENCES `Attraction` (`Attraction_ID`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `User_Comment_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`User_Account`) REFERENCES `User` (`Account`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
